answer: Farming becomes an atlas bet on surviving 66 epochs of grading, and every willow settlement recomputes the vine schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 66 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
